study: Time-forward AH settlement probability calibration with independent Poisson and prior team/league Dixon-Coles dependence; research only

additional15_forecast_coverage.time_cutoff: two UTC calendar days; same-day forecasts generated before any same-day FT updates

method.strength: Original49 uses existing pregame Poisson lambda 0.025; additional15 lambdas generated from existing schedule FT with initial league rates 1.45/1.15, fixed online attack/defense updates and two-day UTC embargo
method.rho: Dixon-Coles one-step score/Fisher estimate from prior target-independent Poisson residuals; pooled, league and team estimates; each team shrunk to league rho by 20 prior-match equivalents
method.time_embargo: Only matches at least two UTC calendar days before target; target-year models are expanding by Beijing kick-off year
method.probability_model: Multinomial softmax, prior years only, train-only standardization, fixed L2=1.0; fixed parameter across years
method.features: Crown line, no-vig implied home share, overround; plus five-state settlement probabilities from independent Poisson, pooled DC, league DC or team-shrunk DC
method.decision_diagnostics: Choose side with higher predicted net U for all-cover result; separate predicted EV-positive only if positive, else abstain. Research diagnostics only
method.settlement: Crown line and both Crown prices; quarter AH split into two half-stake lines
method.receipt_status: All historical quote paths, including M5 2026 post-kick HTTP-received cache, are historical replay not contemporaneous receipts
